comment: pescldSourceProfile.json: what the PESC_LD v0.0.2 CSV snapshot holds and how each column is carried, as DATA (zeroBacklog lane C1, 2026-10-22). The loader refuses a header that departs from these tables; the walk reads its carriage from them. Measured over snapshot 01: shapes.csv 39 records, seven TAP files 270 records (266 distinct shape/property pairs), namespaces.csv 47 prefixes. The round-trip pair reads ONLY the file names and the column names from here; its graph-side readings are its own.
tapFileNameListComment: the publisher's own merge order (the combined TTL's header: shacl.ttl, person, organization, contact, course-related, achieve-related, summary-related)

tapColumnList.reason: a spreadsheet row number, filled on 167 of 270 records; not an identity and not a statement about the profile

conflictResolutionListComment: a (shape, property) pair the source states twice with DIFFERENT cell text in one column is refused unless listed here. Measured 2026-10-21/22: exactly one such pair. The resolution follows the publisher's own merge (the combined TTL emits sh:minCount 1 with sh:severity sh:Warning); both source values are carried on the node.

conflictResolutionList.rule: the publisher's merged TTL takes TRUE (sh:minCount 1, sh:severity sh:Warning); person-tap.csv says FALSE, summary-related-tap.csv says TRUE
